title: VirtualExtensionRangeValidationStatusEnum
description:
* `VALID` - Validation is successful.
 * `DUPLICATE` - Duplicate patterns for virtual extension range.
 * `DUPLICATE_IN_LIST` - Duplicate routing number in the pattern list.
 * `INVALID` - Invalid prefix length.
 * `LIMIT_EXCEEDED` - Exceeding pattern limit of 100 in the request.
